capabilities: Sort checkbox todos by completion status when a file is opened
Rank tasks across four statuses: incomplete, in-progress, completed, canceled
Configure whether completed tasks go to the top or bottom
extras: Sorting runs only on file open, not on every edit; the README links to a demo video.
intentEvidence: Developed by @jsifalda (forked version of Ryan Gomba)
motivation: Inspired by the need for better task management within Obsidian notes.
problem: Obsidian leaves checkbox tasks in the order they were written, so completed and canceled items clutter the list and hide what still needs doing.

relations.evidence: Developed by @jsifalda (forked version of Ryan Gomba)

summary: Task sorter that automatically reorders checkbox todos in a note by completion status when the file is opened.
